headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Insights
summary: Utilize public trend signals to improve ClearInstall’s dependency analysis, ensuring users are informed about potential risks associated with new PostgreSQL versions and other critical dependencies before installation. Integrate real-time updates for binding.gyp command expansions and enhance the user interface to reflect these changes seamlessly.
actions: Integrate real-time dependency alerts based on signals like Postgres 19 delays, informing users of upcoming changes that might affect their projects.
Update the ClearInstall UI to highlight any dependencies that are currently under development or have known issues, such as binding.gyp command expansions.
Implement a feature that checks for and warns about potential security risks associated with new versions of dependencies, using signals like Anthropic's intern
